latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Liking Factor Engineer skill.

- Enables analysis and engineering of audience liking to boost rapport, persuasion, and compliance in marketing, sales, and communication.
- Supports both "application" (build liking) and "defense" (detect/manipulate) modes.
- Audits scenarios and content against five key liking factors: attractiveness, similarity, compliments, familiarity/contact, and association.
- Accepts both document and verbal scenario descriptions as input.
- Offers strategy recommendations if no existing content is provided.
